                               actual_sha256: str, actual_size: int) -> dict:

    The envelope record is transport metadata about the original file (role
    SOURCE_FILE, contentDelivery IMMUTABLE_INPUT_FILE_ONLY). It is used here
    only to prove WHICH single original was selected and that its declared
    chunk integrity metadata matches the verified bytes. Its numeric fields are
    Decimal because JSON cells are decoded with parse_float/parse_int=Decimal.
    """

        raise BindingError(f"expected 1 envelope logical row, got {len(logical_rows)}")

            "envelope datasetReference is not the exact delivered CSV asset key: "
            f"{row['datasetReference']!r}"

    if not isinstance(record, dict):
        raise BindingError(f"envelope record is not a JSON object: {type(record).__name__}")

        ok = declared == observed

            "field": field,
            "declaredInEnvelope": str(declared),
            "observedFromVerifiedBytes": str(observed),
            "match": ok,
            "note": note,

        "declaredInEnvelope": "absent",
        "observedFromVerifiedBytes": "absent",
        "match": True,
        "note": "no encoded payload delivered, so no chunk decode/concat path applies",
    })

        "logicalFields": sorted(row),
        "recordFieldNames": sorted(record),
        "recordDecimalTypedFields": sorted(
            name for name, val in record.items() if isinstance(val, Decimal)
